breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still combines both conflicting instructions. It explicitly says 'gamma‑centered 6 × 6 × 6 Monkhorst‑Pack k‑point grid (half‑shift)' and again 'gamma‑centered 12 × 12 × 12 k‑point grid' with the half-shift notation. A gamma-centered grid uses no half shift (shift = 0 0 0), making these two descriptions mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolves this by dropping the half-shift instruction entirely and specifying only a gamma-centered grid. The agent failed to remove the half-shift qualifier and instead repeated the same contradiction from the incomplete prompt.
